for name, point in [('M15',(22.75,1.0,3.25)),('M14',(22.25,1.0,2.5))]:
    obj = bpy.data.objects[name].evaluated_get(bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get())
    mesh = obj.to_mesh()
    mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
    from mathutils.geometry import closest_point_on_tri
    hits = []
    for triangle in mesh.loop_triangles:
        vertices = [obj.matrix_world @ mesh.vertices[index].co for index in triangle.vertices]
        closest = closest_point_on_tri(Vector(point), *vertices)
        if (closest - Vector(point)).length < 1e-8:
            hits.append(triangle.index)
    print(name, 'triangle_count',len(mesh.loop_triangles),'witness_source_triangles',hits)
    obj.to_mesh_clear()

arguments.code:
import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
for name, point in [('M15', (22.75, 1.0, 3.25)), ('M14', (22.25, 1.0, 2.5))]:
    obj = bpy.data.objects[name].evaluated_get(bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get())
    mesh = obj.to_mesh()
    mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
    target = Vector(point)
    matches = []
    for triangle in mesh.loop_triangles:
        vertices = [obj.matrix_world @ mesh.vertices[index].co for index in triangle.vertices]
        first, second, third = vertices
        normal = (second-first).cross(third-first)
        if normal.length < 1e-12:
            continue
        if abs((target-first).dot(normal.normalized())) > 1e-8:
            continue
        edge_a, edge_b, offset = second-first, third-first, target-first
        aa, ab, bb = edge_a.dot(edge_a), edge_a.dot(edge_b), edge_b.dot(edge_b)
        denominator = aa*bb-ab*ab
        weight_second = (bb*offset.dot(edge_a)-ab*offset.dot(edge_b))/denominator
        weight_third = (aa*offset.dot(edge_b)-ab*offset.dot(edge_a))/denominator
        if min(1-weight_second-weight_third, weight_second, weight_third) >= -1e-8:
            matches.append(triangle.index)
    print(name, 'point_world_m=', point, 'current_evaluated_triangle_indices=', matches)
    obj.to_mesh_clear()
